1.title: Trump Heads to Ireland for the Irish Open at His Golf Course
1.summary: President Trump’s trip comes after a two-day Republican rally in Dallas, where he tried to energize voters amid fears that the party could face losses in the midterms.

2.title: 'Never, ever forget' - America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
2.summary: In New York, the Pentagon and Pennsylvania, solemn ceremonies commemorate the landmark anniversary.

3.title: Women Special Operations Veterans Remember Their Battles
3.summary: The only fraternal organization for women special operations veterans held a gala to mark the wars that began 25 years ago. It came as the Pentagon questions women’s roles in the military.

4.title: Arrest made over the death of black woman found hanged from tree
4.summary: Tasia Fortune's body was found  in the lot of an abandoned home in Mississippi in August.

5.title: Why Emerging Powers Keep Joining BRICS, Even When They Disagree
5.summary: The leaders of China, Russia, India, Iran and other nations in the BRICS club gather in New Delhi this weekend, but wars and soaring energy prices divide them.

6.title: Houthis Seize a Key Red Sea Island, Threatening Another Global Oil Route
6.summary: The militia captured the island in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a choke point for trade. Saudi Arabia also announced it had shut down a critical oil pipeline after a drone attack launched from Iraq.
